title: DiligenceSquared uses AI, voice agents to make M&A research affordable
description: Instead of relying on expensive management consultants, the startup uses AI voice agents to conduct interviews with customers of the companies the PE firms are considering buying.
author: Marina Temkin

title: AWS launches a new AI agent platform specifically for healthcare
description: AWS is launching Amazon Connect Health, an AI agent platform that will help with patient scheduling, documentation, and patient verification.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: US reportedly considering sweeping new chip export controls
description: In an alleged drafted proposal, the U.S. government would play a role in every chip export sale regardless of which country it's coming from.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: It’s official: The Pentagon has labeled Anthropic a supply chain risk
description: The Department of Defense has officially labeled Anthropic a supply chain risk, making the AI firm the first American company with the label. Meanwhile, the DOD continues to use Anthropic's AI in Iran.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: EXCLUSIVE: Luma launches creative AI agents powered by its new ‘Unified Intelligence’ models
description: Luma introduced Luma Agents, powered by its new “Unified Intelligence” models, designed to coordinate multiple AI systems and generate end-to-end creative work across text, images, video and audio.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: OpenAI launches GPT-5.4 with Pro and Thinking versions
description: GPT-5.4 is billed as "our most capable and efficient frontier model for professional work."
author: Russell Brandom

title: Cursor is rolling out a new kind of agentic coding tool
description: Called Automations, the new system gives users a way to automatically launch agents within their coding environment, triggered by a new addition to the codebase, a Slack message, or a simple timer.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Meta sued over AI smart glasses’ privacy concerns, after workers reviewed nudity, sex, and other footage
description: Lawyers say Meta's marketing materials promised privacy and user control over sharing footage. But an investigation found that subcontractors are reviewing footage from customers' glasses.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei could still be trying to make a deal with Pentagon
description: Anthropic's $200 million contract with the Department of Defense broke down due to disagreements over giving the military unrestricted access to its AI.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Netflix buys Ben Affleck’s AI filmmaking company InterPositive
description: InterPositive isn't trying to make AI actors or synthetic performances. Rather, the company has created a model that helps production teams work with footage from their own productions to help make edits in post-production.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: How 1,000+ customer calls shaped a breakout enterprise AI startup
description: On this episode of Build Mode, David Park joins Isabelle Johannessen to discuss how he and his team are intentionally iterating, fundraising, and scaling Narada.
author: Maggie Nye, Isabelle Johannessen

title: Lio raises $30M from Andreessen Horowitz and others to automate enterprise procurement
description: AI procurement startup Lio announced a $30 million Series A in a round led by Andreessen Horowitz.
author: Dominic-Madori Davis

title: Jensen Huang says Nvidia is pulling back from OpenAI and Anthropic, but his explanation raises more questions than it answers
description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said Wednesday that his company's investments in OpenAI and Anthropic will likely be its last — but his explanation may not tell the whole story.
author: Connie Loizos

title: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei calls OpenAI’s messaging around military deal ‘straight up lies,’ report says
description: Anthropic gave up its contract with the Pentagon over AI safety disagreements -- then, OpenAI swooped in.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Apple Music to add Transparency Tags to distinguish AI music, says report
description: The label or distributor has to opt in to tagging their music as AI, so it's unclear how effective this intervention will be.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Google Search rolls out Gemini’s Canvas in AI Mode to all US users
description: Canvas in AI Mode is available to U.S. users in English for creating plans, projects, apps, and more.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Google’s Gemini rolls out Canvas in AI Mode to all US users
description: Canvas in AI Mode is available to U.S. users in English for creating plans, projects, apps, and more.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Decagon completes first tender offer at $4.5B valuation
description: The AI-powered customer support startup is the latest example of a fast-growing, young company that's providing employee liquidity.
author: Marina Temkin

title: The US military is still using Claude — but defense-tech clients are fleeing
description: As the U.S. continues its aerial attack on Iran, Anthropic models are being used for many targeting decisions.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Father sues Google, claiming Gemini chatbot drove son into fatal delusion
description: A father is suing Google and Alphabet, alleging its Gemini chatbot reinforced his son’s delusional belief it was his AI wife and coached him toward suicide and a planned airport attack.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: One startup’s pitch to provide more reliable AI answers: crowdsource the chatbots
description: CollectivIQ looks to give users more accurate answers to their AI queries by showing them responses that pull information from ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok — and up to 10 other models — all at the same time.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Who needs data centers in space when they can float offshore?
description: Offshore wind developer Aikido will deploy a small data center beneath a floating offshore wind turbine later this year.
author: Tim De Chant

title: Why AI startups are selling the same equity at two different prices
description: Some AI founders are using a novel valuation mechanism to manufacture unicorn status.
author: Marina Temkin

title: Alibaba’s Qwen tech lead steps down after major AI push
description: Reactions rippled through Alibaba's Qwen team after tech lead Junyang Lin stepped down following a major model launch.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: AI companies are spending millions to thwart this former tech exec’s congressional bid
description: A tech billionaire-backed super PAC is spending $125 million to undercut candidates pushing for AI regulation. New York's Alex Bores, a former tech executive himself, is one of them.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: ChatGPT’s new GPT-5.3 Instant model will stop telling you to calm down
description: The company says the new model will reduce the "cringe" that's been annoying its users for months.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Claude Code rolls out a voice mode capability
description: Anthropic is stepping up its game in the AI coding space with the rollout of Voice Mode in Claude Code.
author: Lauren Forristal

title: X says it will suspend creators from revenue-sharing program for unlabeled AI posts of ‘armed conflict’
description: Creators who break the rules will get a three-month suspension, and if they continue to violate the policy, they'll be permanently banned.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Cursor has reportedly surpassed $2B in annualized revenue
description: The four-year-old startup saw its revenue run rate double over the past three months, according to one Bloomberg source.
author: Marina Temkin

title: ChatGPT uninstalls surged by 295% after DoD deal
description: Many consumers ditched ChatGPT's app after news of its DoD deal went live, while Claude's downloads grew.
author: Sarah Perez
